changes_made.explanation: Normalized task names to standard forms using title case. Added missing Named Entity Recognition task and associated datasets mentioned in the paper. Removed 'Other:' prefix since these are standard NLP tasks. Expanded dataset abbreviations to full names.
The extracted metrics are correct and already in canonical form. The paper uses Exact Match and F1 scores for evaluating question answering and named entity recognition outputs.
No LLMs are used as judges/evaluators in this paper. The models mentioned (BERT, RoBERTa, T5) are used for the main tasks, not for evaluation.
The paper only uses automatic metrics (Exact Match, F1) for evaluation and does not mention any human evaluation.

overall_notes: This paper presents KALA, a framework for adapting pre-trained language models to specific domains using knowledge graphs. While the paper addresses NLG tasks (specifically question answering and named entity recognition), its primary focus is on model adaptation and enhancement rather than evaluation methodology. The extraction was generally accurate but missed some important details about the full experimental setup.
